evidence_method: Static printable help bytes read from previously verified signed binary; client not executed for this check.
retry_timeout_help_fragment:
--retry-timeout=SECS            Advisory - caller indicates it will rerun
                                    ascp on failure
interpretation: This option advertises that a caller will rerun ascp. It is not used. Helper launches one direct client invocation and no Aspera CLI retry wrapper. -k0 disables resume, not protocol retransmission. Internal packet-level retries/reconnects were not claimed absent.
